d: America is facing fresh concerns over its increasingly fragile technology infrastructure. A system malfunction at Delta Air Lines disrupted operations, delaying more than 1,600 flights and exposing the risks of relying on automated systems. The incident comes as US intelligence chief Jay Clayton warns that more technology glitches could hit businesses and government agencies amid major system upgrades. From aviation and banking to communications and national security, America's dependence on digital infrastructure is growing. Are these isolated technical failures or signs of a larger…
